push-press: Stand with the bar resting on the front of your shoulders, hands just outside shoulder width, feet hip-width apart.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright and your heels down.
Drive straight up through your legs and use that momentum to press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Finish with the bar over the middle of your feet, then lower it back to your shoulders under control.
single-arm-kb-swing: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders, the kettlebell on the floor just in front of you.
Hinge at the hips, grip the handle with one hand and hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing the bell up to chest height, arm straight and core braced.
Let it fall back between your legs, hinge again and go straight into the next swing. Switch hands between sets.
power-clean: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, the bar over the middle of your feet, hands just outside your knees and back flat.
Push the floor away to lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close to your shins and your back angle the same.
As the bar passes mid-thigh, drive your hips forward hard, rise onto your toes and shrug.
Pull yourself under the bar into a quarter squat and catch it on the front of your shoulders, elbows high.
Stand up tall, then lower the bar to your thighs and down to the floor under control.
